published_figures.figure: Type certificate data sheet 2A13, section III: the Sensenich M76EMMS propeller's static rpm at full throttle, "not over 2450, not under 2275".

Section I: take-off run, maximum effort, 25 degrees of flap, 720 ft, at gross weight, sea level, standard conditions. Section III's technique: "accelerate to 50 to 60 MPH, then ease back on the wheel enough to let the airplane fly itself off the ground"; eased back here at 55 mph, 47.8 knots.
Section I: rate of climb 725 ft/min at the best rate of climb speed, 85 mph (73.9 knots), gross weight, sea level, full throttle.
Section I: optimum cruising speed, 75% power at optimum altitude, 143 mph (124.3 knots); section V's power setting table gives 75% at 7,000 ft as 2,640 rpm, the propeller being fixed.
Section I: top speed 152 mph (132.1 knots), at gross weight, sea level, full throttle.
Airplane Flight Manual, stalling speeds, power off, 2,400 lb, flaps up: 67 mph CAS (58.2 knots); the handbook's stall speed table gives the same. 2 knots either side.
Airplane Flight Manual, flaps down (40 degrees): 57 mph CAS (49.5 knots). 2 knots either side.
